title: Smaller audit reply: software example before model runs
instructions: Inputs, expected output, actual older output, current software result and differences are shown in order. This early example exposes the change while work is underway. A reply must cover every assigned paragraph once. Concerns must quote the exact text from the stated original, software or older-proposal layer and give a supported reading or explicit uncertainty. The software checks where quotes belong; it does not certify the proposed image reading. The agent’s expected examples are saved separately and are not included in the new model prompt. These are selected checks, not independent human gold.

evidence.text:

That request took 182.97 seconds and returned 1,500 output tokens before stopping at the cap. Its JSON is incomplete and invalid. The visible claim conflicts with the chapter numeral in the scan. No new Qwen reply exists yet.

evidence.label: 3 · Actual software check: authored format illustration
4 · Differences and the next three-run test
evidence.text:
The proposed format has one coverage record per paragraph and concise concerns, replacing separate inspection and repeated checklist records. It still requires checking all words, names, punctuation, repetition, genuine hyphens and actual numbers, including dates and chapter/section numerals. Word counts are not the numeric quantities intended here.

Implementation and checks are underway. Next, freeze exactly three independent identical-input Qwen calls, each at most five minutes and 1,500 output tokens. Preserve bad, invalid, uncertain or known-truncated observations and continue planned repetitions when usage and owned shutdown are known and the budget permits. Unknown usage or owned exit and exhausted limits still stop dependent calls. The first actual observation will be shown before runs two and three. Comments are optional; no permission request or production acceptance is implied.
